## General criteria
Recreation fee assistance helps eligible city residents reduce program fees for youth, senior, and adaptive recreation programs. The published criteria include city residency and household income documentation.

## Using the benefit
Approved assistance is applied to eligible recreation programs until the annual benefit is used.
